deck: WattZap — Company Introduction for Legal Partners
title: Compliance support we need to go live
subtitle: Where we need your advice before commercial launch
a11yLabel: Four compliance areas where WattZap seeks legal advice: corporate and tax, data protection, energy sector rules, and website and consumer law.

cards.heading: Corporate & Tax
bullets: Company structure and Companies Act 2013 filings
GST registration and invoicing for savings-share fees
State registrations: Shops & Establishments, professional tax

cards.heading: Data Protection
bullets: DPDP Act 2023 readiness for customer energy data
Consent, notices and retention for metering data
Platform privacy policy and processor terms

cards.heading: Energy Sector Rules
bullets: Electricity Act 2003 and state regulator norms
EV charging guidelines and DISCOM interfaces
Licences or exemptions our model actually needs

cards.heading: Website & Consumer
bullets: Terms of service for the platform and website
Consumer protection view on published savings claims

content.note: Working draft — we want your view on the full checklist, not just these items.
